newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves at historic high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves at historic high.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves reached an all-time high of $9.935 billion as of March 21, the latest date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
The previous high was registered on December 30 of last year, when net reserves totaled $9.896 billion.
The Banco de La Republica, or central bank, has forecast net reserves will rise by $750 million this year to a total of $10.5 billion.

The increase so far this year has been partly fueled by a sharp rise in foreign loans to the private sector. Such loans totaled $422.9 million between January and March 21, up from $295 million during the same period last year.
